messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Error read.cross
parts:
Try sep=";", and also use genotypes=c("A","AB","B")

data1 <- read.cross("csv", file="ExampleReadCross.csv", sep=";", genotypes=c("A", "AB", "B"))

Note that there are some "104" and "304" values in the genotype data for some reason.

karl
